EU-Hydro

  • Show All Code

The Copernicus river network of Europe at 1:50,000, whose own metadata say Kosovo has no water-body data, yet whose rivers run through it.

Complete · Last checked: 29 September 2026

At a glance

Field Value
Custodian Copernicus Land Monitoring Service, coordinated by the EEA
Primary URL https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/eu-hydro/eu-hydro-river-network-database
DOI 10.2909/393359a7-7ebd-4a52-80ac-1a18d5f3db9c
Licence Copernicus full, free and open data policy (attribution required)
Access open
Format File Geodatabase, GeoPackage (by major basin)
Access method download; WMS; ArcGIS REST
Spatial resolution 1:50,000; minimum mapping unit 1 ha
Temporal coverage 2006–2012
Latest version Version 1.3, November 2020 (revised 2020-11-25)
Kosovo coverage partial
Kosovo codes seen not applicable (no country attribute queried)
Precision tier national
Natura 2000 question River network and Strahler order, for freshwater Annex I types, fish and boundary lines along rivers
Integration effort low
Sensitivity None

What it is

EU-Hydro is the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service’s photo-interpreted river network for the EEA38 countries and the United Kingdom: river lines ordered by Strahler number, inland water polygons, and a drainage model derived from the EU-DEM. Version 1.3 (November 2020) is mapped at 1:50,000 with a 1 ha minimum mapping unit, has a DOI, and is free and open under the Copernicus data policy, with attribution.

Its metadata contain a sentence that bears directly on Kosovo: for Türkiye, Albania, Bosnia-Herzegovina, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Kosovo and Serbia, “no spatial data for any category of water bodies was available”. Taken at face value that would make the product useless here. The check below shows it is not.

Access

Show the code 
access_table(list(
  try_access("https://sdi.eea.europa.eu/catalogue/srv/api/records/393359a7-7ebd-4a52-80ac-1a18d5f3db9c"),
  try_access(paste0(svc, "?f=json"))
))
Address Request Outcome Type Size Checked
https://sdi.eea.europa.eu/catalogue/srv/api/records/393359a7-7ebd-4a52-80ac-1a18d5f3db9c HEAD HTTP 200 text/html 102 kB 2026-09-29 16:43 CEST
https://image.discomap.eea.europa.eu/arcgis/rest/services/EUHydro/EUHydro_RiverNetworkDatabase/MapServer?f=json HEAD HTTP 200 application/json size not reported 2026-09-29 16:43 CEST

Downloads are per major basin as File Geodatabase or GeoPackage; the check uses the EEA’s map service instead, which needs no download.

Show the map-service query 
build_error <- NULL
if (!file.exists(cache)) {
  build_error <- tryCatch({
    source("../R/functions.R", local = TRUE)
    ko <- st_transform(st_union(kosovo_outline()), 3035)
    bb <- st_bbox(st_transform(ko, 4326))
    rivers <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(strahler_layers), function(o) {
      # A layer with nothing in the box, or nothing left after clipping, is
      # skipped rather than allowed to stop the build.
      x <- tryCatch(arcgis_query_sf(paste0(svc, "/", strahler_layers[[o]]), bb,
                                    fields = "OBJECTID", verbose = FALSE),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
      x <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(st_make_valid(x), ko))
      x <- suppressWarnings(st_collection_extract(x, "LINESTRING"))
      if (!nrow(x)) return(NULL)
      st_sf(strahler = rep(as.integer(o), nrow(x)), geometry = st_geometry(x))
    }))
    water <- arcgis_query_sf(paste0(svc, "/2"), bb, fields = "OBJECTID", verbose = FALSE)
    water <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(st_make_valid(water), ko))
    st_write(rivers, cache, layer = "rivers", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
    st_write(st_sf(geometry = st_geometry(water)), cache, layer = "inland_water",
             append = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)
    NULL
  }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
}
have_cache <- file.exists(cache)

Kosovo coverage check

Strahler order River length inside Kosovo (km)
3 522
4 333
5 162
6 20

Inside Kosovo the network holds 1,038 km of rivers of Strahler order 3 and above, and 27 inland-water polygons covering 2,256 ha. Kosovo is therefore partly covered: the river network and some water bodies are mapped, whatever the metadata say. The service carries no country attribute on these layers, so no country code was checked.

What it adds for Natura 2000 in Kosovo

Freshwater habitats (3260 water courses, 91E0 alluvial forests, 92A0 willow and poplar galleries) and Annex II fish follow the river network, and a Strahler order separates headwater streams from the main rivers. River lines are also natural site boundaries. EU-Hydro is one network for all the EEA’s member and cooperating countries, which makes it a natural choice for a Kosovo network meant to join its neighbours’. At 1:50,000 it serves the national tier and outlines for sites.

Caveats and sensitivity

  • The metadata’s statement about Kosovo conflicts with what the service returns; which parts were derived without national data is unknown.
  • Lines of Strahler order 1 and 2 were left out of this check to keep it light; they are in the service.
  • No sensitive content.

Integration into the pipeline

Low effort. A proposed kosovo_rivers(boundary, min_strahler = 3) in R/functions.R, using the existing arcgis_query_sf(), would cache the network for the report’s maps and for the freshwater part of the habitat screen. pipeline.R is not changed.

To be completed

```{r}
#| label: setup
source("../R/sources_helpers.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(sf)
  library(leaflet)
})
row <- source_row("eu-hydro")
cache <- file.path(cache_dir("eu-hydro"), "eu_hydro_kosovo.gpkg")
svc <- "https://image.discomap.eea.europa.eu/arcgis/rest/services/EUHydro/EUHydro_RiverNetworkDatabase/MapServer"
strahler_layers <- c(`3` = 7, `4` = 8, `5` = 9, `6` = 10, `7` = 11)
```

      # A layer with nothing in the box, or nothing left after clipping, is

                                    fields = "OBJECTID", verbose = FALSE),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
      x <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(st_make_valid(x), ko))
      x <- suppressWarnings(st_collection_extract(x, "LINESTRING"))
      if (!nrow(x)) return(NULL)
      st_sf(strahler = rep(as.integer(o), nrow(x)), geometry = st_geometry(x))
    }))
    water <- arcgis_query_sf(paste0(svc, "/2"), bb, fields = "OBJECTID", verbose = FALSE)
    water <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(st_make_valid(water), ko))
    st_write(rivers, cache, layer = "rivers", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

## Kosovo coverage check

```{r}
#| label: check
#| eval: !expr have_cache
rivers <- st_read(cache, layer = "rivers", quiet = TRUE)
water  <- st_read(cache, layer = "inland_water", quiet = TRUE)
len <- tapply(as.numeric(st_length(rivers)) / 1000, rivers$strahler, sum)
knitr::kable(data.frame(`Strahler order` = names(len),
                        `River length inside Kosovo (km)` = fmt_int(len),
                        check.names = FALSE), align = "rr", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: check-text
#| eval: !expr have_cache
#| output: asis
cat(sprintf(paste(
  "Inside Kosovo the network holds %s km of rivers of Strahler order 3 and",
  "above, and %d inland-water polygons covering %s ha. Kosovo is therefore",
  "partly covered: the river network and some water bodies are mapped,",
  "whatever the metadata say. The service carries no country attribute on",
  "these layers, so no country code was checked."),
  fmt_int(sum(len)), nrow(water), fmt_int(sum(as.numeric(st_area(water))) / 1e4)))
```

```{r}
#| label: map
#| eval: !expr have_cache
source("../R/functions.R", local = TRUE)
pal <- colorNumeric(c("#9ECAE1", "#08306B"), domain = rivers$strahler)
leaflet(st_transform(rivers, 4326)) |>
  add_basemaps() |>
  addPolylines(color = ~pal(strahler), weight = ~strahler / 1.5, opacity = 0.9,
               label = ~paste("Strahler order", strahler)) |>
  addPolygons(data = st_transform(water, 4326), color = "#0072B2", weight = 1,
              fillOpacity = 0.5) |>
  add_boundary_outline(kosovo_outline()) |>
  addLegend(pal = pal, values = ~strahler, title = "Strahler order") |>
  addLayersControl(baseGroups = basemap_groups,
                   options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = TRUE))
```
